name: Next Button
description: Call-to-action buttons in 12 current-generation designs from the Next Collection, covering motion (border beam, shimmer sweep, rainbow glow, pulse ring), depth (mechanical keycap, layered stack, magnetic float), bold aesthetics (neo-brutal, clay, holographic foil) and smart shape changes (icon that morphs into a label, hold-to-confirm fill). Motion designs adapt Magic UI's shimmer, rainbow, pulsating and border-beam buttons; every color is resolved from the Universal Theme palette so the buttons follow Vita, Vita Dark, Redwood and Theme Roller. Report mode renders a wrapping action bar.
helpText: Use for one or two prominent calls to action per page and keep native Universal Theme buttons for ordinary form actions. Set Link to render an anchor; without a link a button is rendered for a Dynamic Action. Map Color to a column returning primary, success, warning, danger or info (anything else renders as primary). Hint is short secondary text: the shortcut legend on Keycap, the instruction under the label on Confirm hold, a small trailing tag elsewhere. Every design has hover, pressed and keyboard focus states, and all motion stops under reduced motion.

attributes.name: Style
attributes.helpText: The button design and its Next Collection direction. Motion: Border beam, Shimmer, Rainbow glow, Pulse ring. Depth: Keycap presses down like a mechanical key, Layered separates a stack of plates on hover, Magnetic floats and follows the pointer. Bold: Neo-brutal, Clay, Holo foil. Smart: Morph icon is an icon circle that expands into its label on hover or focus and stays expanded on touch screens; Confirm hold fills while pressed and shows a check when the hold completes, as visual feedback only, so keep a confirmation in the Dynamic Action for destructive actions.

attributes.name: Label
attributes.helpText: Visible button text and its accessible name. Use a specific verb, for example Create Order or Approve Invoice. Morph icon hides it visually until hover or focus, but screen readers always read it.

attributes.name: Link
attributes.helpText: Target URL, for example f?p=&APP_ID.:10:&SESSION. When set an anchor is rendered, otherwise a button for a Dynamic Action. Must be a developer-controlled value, never raw user input.

attributes.name: Icon
attributes.helpText: Font APEX icon class, for example fa-plus or fa-trash. Morph icon, Magnetic float and Confirm hold draw an arrow when it is empty.

attributes.name: Hint
attributes.helpText: Optional short secondary text: the shortcut legend on Keycap, for example Ctrl S; the instruction under the label on Confirm hold, for example Hold to confirm; a small trailing tag in the other designs, for example New or 3.

attributes.name: Color
attributes.helpText: Palette color: primary, success, warning, danger or info. Empty or any other value renders as primary. Can be static text or a column. Holo foil and Rainbow glow use the whole palette and take the color only for the focus ring and icon.

attributes.name: Size
attributes.helpText: Leave empty for the default size, or choose Small or Large.
